reasoning: Plan A is the superior training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates more targeted interval work designed to improve threshold and high-end aerobic power, crucial for speed gains. Plan B, while consistent, lacks this focused intensity and relies heavily on longer, easier runs, which are beneficial for endurance but won't directly translate to faster times. Plan A’s inclusion of cross-training also provides a valuable recovery component and varied stimulus. Furthermore, the inclusion of two dedicated threshold interval sessions is a key differentiator.
